entries.2ef1967232e0bd1b: Komeda Co., Ltd. operates the coffee shop FC business under the brands "Kohisho Komeda Coffee" and "Okagean", and for FC franchisees provides services such as selection of store opening properties, provision of know-how on design and construction of store buildings and interiors, coffee shop operation guidance, manufacture and wholesale of food materials, and subleasing of store buildings.
entries.669301357fa10ca0: Taiwan Komeda Co., Ltd. operates the coffee shop FC business and directly managed stores in Taiwan under the brand "Kohisho Komeda Coffee", and PT KOMEDA COFFEE INDONESIA operates directly managed stores in Indonesia.
entries.94189a378c051045: Komeda Co., Ltd. runs an FC business of coffee shops under the brands "Kohi-dokoro Komeda Coffee Ten" and "OkageAn", and for FC members it selects store properties, provides know-how for the design and construction of store buildings and interiors, gives coffee shop operation guidance, manufactures and wholesales food materials, and subleases store buildings. Ryukyu Komeda Co., Ltd. operates directly managed stores mainly in Okinawa Prefecture, and Komeda Commerce Co., Ltd. operates directly managed stores mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area under brands such as "Hamburger & Sandwich Beisu" and "BLUE LEAF CAFÉ". Revenue from external customers of the segment is ¥51,374 million.
entries.c20bef995c338fb1: This is a holding company of a restaurant group that operates, centered on the full-service coffee shop "Kohisho Komeda Coffee", FC businesses and directly managed stores in Japan and overseas.
entries.d3de1782ee27b894: A holding company headquartered in Higashi Ward, Nagoya, forming a group of the company and 8 consolidated subsidiaries. In Japan, it operates FC businesses and directly managed stores of full-service coffee shops under the brands "Kohi-dokoro Komeda Coffee Ten" and "OkageAn"; overseas, it operates "Kohi-dokoro Komeda Coffee Ten" in Taiwan, Shanghai, Hong Kong and Indonesia, and restaurants such as "Kaffe & Toast" and "Saap Saap Thai" in Singapore. There are 2 reportable segments, the domestic business and the overseas business; the number of employees in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was 828, and the number of stores at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year was 1,150.
entries.db53e2d4972d7e12: Taiwan Kemeiduo Co., Ltd. operates an FC business and directly managed stores of coffee shops in Taiwan under the brand "Kohi-dokoro Komeda Coffee Ten", and PT KOMEDA COFFEE INDONESIA operates directly managed stores in Indonesia. In Singapore, POON RESOURCES PTE. LTD. operates restaurants such as cafes under brands including "Kaffe & Toast" and "Saap Saap Thai". Revenue from external customers of the segment is ¥5,851 million.
entries.dd6e60efbfccf47f: A holding company headquartered in Higashi-ku, Nagoya, whose group consists of the company and 8 consolidated subsidiaries.
